h: Ruth Kadiri says couples do not need an expensive wedding
p: The Nollywood actress has spoken about the pressure lavish ceremonies place on couples. She argues that a marriage matters more than the size of the party. Her comments come days after Zlatan Ibile's star-studded wedding dominated timelines.
more: She urged couples to spend within their means.
Reactions online have been largely supportive.
